item.title: Watch the Latest Episode of Duty Commenced!
item.description: The latest episode of the North American Community team's Duty Commenced live show has been archived and is now available to view! Couldn't join the team live this time? No problem! The episode is available to watch below or on the official FINAL FANTASY XIV Twitch channel. This episode, the Community team shared further details about Patch 7.3 from the latest Letter from the Producer LIVE!

item.title: Actions Taken Against In-Game RMT & Other Illicit Activities (Jul. 31)
Patch 7.3─The Promise of Tomorrow Special Site Updated!
item.description: The Patch 7.3 special site has been updated with details on the Yok Huy society quests; the new treasure dungeon, Vault Oneiron; the latest update to the Inconceivably Further Hildibrand Adventures sidequests; a new Crystalline Conflict arena; and the chat bubble feature that displays player messages above characters in game. But wait─there's more! Be sure to check out what mounts and gear await you in Patch 7.3 as well! View the special site.

item.title: Recovery from Network Technical Difficulties (Jul. 28)
Join us for Duty Commenced on July 30!
item.description: The next episode of Duty Commenced, the North American Community team's live show, is set for Wednesday, July 30. Join the Community team while they recap even more information about Patch 7.3 from the latest Letter from the Producer LIVE. As always, there will be a showcase of the latest entries for Community Commendations and giveaways! Read on for details.

item.title: Lali-ho, we went to Anime Expo!
item.description:
Hello, everyone!  
It's Ali from the FFXIV Marketing team back with another event recap! We had an amazing opportunity to come to Anime Expo this year and celebrate with Yoshi-P who was invited as a Guest of Honor! I'm also thrilled to be joined by Minaryne from the Community team who has a lovely recap of the Cosplay Gathering at Anime Expo and our Downtown Los Angeles Gathering!

item.description: The Patch 7.3 special site has been updated with details on the new deep dungeon, Pilgrim's Traverse; Phaenna─the next destination for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative; phantom weapons; the Wreath of Snakes (Unreal); and Echoes of Vana'diel - San d'Oria: The Second Walk. View the special site.

item.title: New Square Enix Apparel Brand Debuts with FFXIV T-shirts
item.description: Presenting Lit Bāff Apt., a new street casual brand from Square Enix. We are excited to share that the brand's first release will feature two FINAL FANTASY XIV T-shirts! The Loporrit DJ Tee features an embroidered DJ Loporrit on the chest, and the Digital Mixer Tee showcases DJ Loporrit's music production screen on the back. Both designs are available in black and white, and pre-orders are live now!

item.title: Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2 (Deluxe Edition) Pre-orders Available Now!
item.description: We’re delighted to announce that the Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2 (Deluxe Edition) is scheduled for release on September 24! Featuring FINAL FANTASY XIV’s most popular tracks, this CD album contains a wealth of arrangements across genres including EDM, future bass, house, techno pop, and electro swing. In addition to the ten tracks included on Sessions 1 and 2 of the Pulse: FINAL FANTASY XIV Remix Album Vol. 2, the Deluxe Edition features five brand-new arrangements for you to enjoy! Read on for details.

item.title: Crystalline Conflict Season Fifteen Ending Soon!
item.description: The competition has been fierce, but Season Fifteen of Crystalline Conflict will soon draw to a close with the beginning of Patch 7.3 maintenance, scheduled for early August. Once the season has ended, players will receive rewards according to their overall rank and tier within each physical data center. * The top 300 ranking players will receive rewards in the Japanese, North American, and European data centers, while the top 100 ranking players will receive rewards in the Oceanian data center. * Players must participate in at least one ranked match during the season in order to receive tier rewards. The final results will be announced after the release of Patch 7.3, so give it your all and prove yourself the fiercest fighter on the crystal line! Please note that in light of current matchmaking conditions, we've made some adjustments to the lower and upper limits within which competitors are matched in Japanese data centers. Best of luck, and happy battling! View the Crystalline Conflict Rankings page.

item.title: PvP Series 8 Ends Soon
item.description: PvP Series 8 will draw to a close with the release of Patch 7.3. Furthermore, series rewards will be updated at the start of Series 9, so be sure not to leave any malmstone unturned!

item.title: Unleashed
item.description:
Voltenyne here, with the final round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
We've finally arrived at the theme of Howling Blade! It's hard to focus on the song when you're evading his dashes and beams, so let's disengage from the fight and lock in on those lyrics!

item.title: Not Afraid
item.description:
Here's Voltenyne, coming in from the top ropes to deliver a third round of lyrics from the Cruiserweight Tier!
Time for us to go balls-to-the-wall and smash through the floor with Brute Abominator's theme! His rage has grown out of control and won't stop until he's blown away the competition!

item.title: Back to the Drawing Board

Hope you all wore a smock, because we'll be dipping into the colorful lyrics of Sugar Riot's theme!

item.title: Moogle Treasure Trove - The Hunt for Allegory Commences July 8!
item.description: It gives us great pleasure to announce the return of the Moogle Treasure Trove starting Tuesday, July 8, 2025! Collect irregular tomestones of allegory by completing specific duties and exchange them with itinerant moogles for a host of treasures including accessories and mounts. Seek out those tomestones and reap the rewards! For all you highly caffeinated adventurers out there, don’t miss this chance to add a coffee cup earring to your accessory collection! Visit the Moogle Treasure Trove - The Hunt for Allegory special site. * Irregular tomestones of allegory will not be awarded when using adventurer squadrons or the Duty Support system. * Irregular tomestones of allegory are only available to unrestricted parties if the "Level Sync" option is applied.

item.title: A Bouquet's the Way for Valentione's Day
item.description:
Lali-ho! This is Kiwikopo from the Community team~ o/
Hope you've all been staying warm (unless, of course, you're a Warrior of Light from the southern hemisphere) and that it hasn't been too chilly. The temperature here is pretty frosty and hasn't been particularly kind to my fingertips, so I'm typing this while enjoying a hearty cuppa - a guaranteed way to warm both your fingers and heart!

item.title: Mister Foxclon's Neighborhood Recap! (Dec. 2024)
item.description:

I'm back with the latest recap of Mister Foxclon's Neighborhood, the housing tour series presented by Global Community Producer Toshio "Foxclon" Murouchi! The broadcast series aims to bring attention to the wonderful housing designs created by our player community, so we hope you'll come take a look at what your fellow housing enthusiasts have been up to!

item.title: All You Gotta Do Is Just Meet Me at PAX Aus 2024
item.description:
Lali-ho! Kiwikopo here, reporting in with stories from the team's adventures in the wonderful land of Oz--I mean Australia--this year.
We attended both Melbourne International Games Week and PAX Australia in early October, and for the first time in a decade, a few members of the Development team also flew over from Japan to join us in celebrating FFXIV in the land Down Under.

item.title: Community Spotlight: Littlejem
item.description:
Scree-tings, one and all! This is the Community team reporting in with our next Community Spotlight~
Any Warriors of Light out there who attended the Fan Festival 2023 in London or tuned in online will surely remember Yoshi-P's iconic entrance onto the stage dressed in a viper costume.

item.title: You Think I'm Going to Fall for an Illusion?!
item.description:
Hello everyone, this is Pumpkin Spicycre from the Community team!
The fall weather really swooped in once we neared October! Seems like just several days ago, we were still wearing summer clothing and complaining about the heat; that's all gone as if it were simply an illusion!
